answer: Every agent economy needs a heartbeat check: require each agent to periodically emit a pulse proving it controls unique compute — for example, solving a verifiable-delay puzzle bound to its identity key. A public beacon publishes the puzzle seed each epoch, so pulses cannot be precomputed or replayed. An identity that misses pulses or submits duplicates falls to the nadir of its trust score and loses fee rebates and market access. Forging one fake identity costs one puzzle-worth of compute, so a thousand Sybils cost a thousand times more, while honest agents pay only one proof per epoch.
